summary: Students, classmates and the places they study.

stages.title: introduction title
stages.text: introduction text: what taking part involves

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Naming classmates"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see a list of classmates. Find everyone the question describes, using the search if it helps, and drag each one into the panel of people you have added.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Naming places"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will be asked a question. For each place who comes to mind, tap the add button, answer a few short questions about them, and save. Move on when you have added everyone.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Naming classmates"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will be asked a question. Tap the add button, then type the name of each classmate who comes to mind and press Enter. Move on when you have added everyone.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "How the classmates you named are connected"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see pairs of the classmates you named. For each pair, choose the answer that describes them best.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "How the classmates you named are connected"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see the classmates you named one at a time. For each one, tap everyone else the question describes, then move on.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "How the classmates you named are connected"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see pairs of the classmates you named. Answer the question for each pair.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "About these relationships"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: Next, you will answer a few questions about each "friends" relationship you described, one at a time.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Sorting the places you named"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see the places you named and a set of boxes. Drag each place into the box that describes them best.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Sorting the classmates you named"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see the classmates you named and a set of boxes. Drag each classmate into the box that describes them best.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "On the map"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see a map. For each of the classmates you named, tap the place the question asks about.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "About the classmates you named"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: Next, you will answer a few questions about each of the classmates you named, one at a time.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Your network map"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft:
On the next screen you will see the places you named on a map, with you at the centre.

Tap each place the question describes. Tap them again to undo.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Your network map"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft:
On the next screen you will see the classmates you named on a map, with you at the centre.

Drag each of the classmates onto the circles. The closer to the centre you place someone, the closer they are to you.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Drawing your network"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: Next, you and the interviewer will draw your network together. Add mentors and move them around. You can answer a few questions about each mentor. You can put mentors into groups. You can draw lines between mentors who are connected.

prompts.draft: Where do you **spend time on campus**?
Who else in your class do you **talk to**?
Tap everyone who **studies with** this person.

questions.draft: Do you agree to take part in this study?
Which year of study are you in?
How many hours a week do you spend there?
Since when have they been friends?
How satisfied are you with university life?
Anything else you would like to tell us?
What is your date of birth?
In which year did you start university?
